name: Data & Utilities
description: Shared runtime data definitions and reusable MonoBehaviour helpers that are not tied to any single game mode or system.

name: Editor Tooling
description: Unity Editor-only extensions including Fusion Hub, inspector customisations, project config tooling, and the README/onboarding ScriptableObject system.

name: Photon Fusion Networking
description: The Photon Fusion 2 runtime and all infrastructure built on top of it: session bootstrap, IL weaving, network object lifecycle, scene synchronisation, multi-runner visibility, and transport layer. All networked game logic depends on this module.

name: Gameplay Systems
description: Core game mechanics for the Shooter mode including player management, health, movement, inventory, enemy AI, and session orchestration. These systems collectively implement the player-facing gameplay loop.

name: User Interface
description: All player-facing UI including the main menu, in-game Shooter HUD (kill feed, nameplates, hotbar), and the real-time network statistics debug panels.
